title: Tom's Kitchen
text:
Tom likes soup very much. Every evening he cooks soup with carrots and potatoes. He eats it with brown bread. Sometimes he adds an onion too.

On weekends, Tom goes to the market with his sister. They buy fresh fruit and cheese. Tom likes apples because they are sweet and cheap.

questions.text: What does Tom cook every evening?
Who does Tom go to the market with?
What can we guess about Tom?
Why do Tom and his sister go to the market?
options: To buy food for their meals

a place where people buy and sell food and other goods
a round vegetable with strong flavour and layers

paragraph_translations: Tomek bardzo lubi zupy. Każdego wieczoru gotuje zupę z marchewką i ziemniakami. Je ją z ciemnym chlebem. Czasami dodaje też cebulę.
W weekendy Tomek chodzi na targ ze swoją siostrą. Kupują świeże owoce i ser. Tomek lubi jabłka, bo są słodkie i tanie.
